placementTime.title: Placement Time
placementTime.help: How long each player has to move their ships into position.

level.title: Map
level.help: Select the map you would like to play in.

levelOrientation.title: Orientation
levelOrientation.help: Select the orientation the level will be displayed in.

shipSpacing.title: Ship Spacing
shipSpacing.help: When enabled, ships must have at least one cell between them and cannot touch each other directly.

shipSpacingAutoMark.title: Ship Spacing: Auto Mark
shipSpacingAutoMark.help: When enabled, if a ship is sunk and 'Ship Spacing' is active, the surrounding cells will automatically be marked as hit, preventing unnecessary shots.

shipReveal.title: Ship Reveal
shipReveal.help: When enabled, you'll see the exact ship you've sunk. Alternatively, you can choose to view only a counter of the remaining ships. If disabled, the number of remaining ships will remain unknown, requiring you to keep track on your own.

hitAfterHit.title: Hit After Hit
hitAfterHit.help: When enabled, you will be allowed to fire again after hitting a ship. When disabled, you only get one shot per turn.
